<text id="443:173" name="Problem Space" x="0" y="0" width="205" height="48" />

<text id="443:174" name="Social platforms let creators build huge audiences but give them little control over who reaches them or how their time is valued. Social DMs are asynchronous and noisy. Clubhouse-style rooms are group-based and unmonetized for individuals. Cameo is pre-recorded, with no real-time interaction. There is no dedicated space for controlled, intentional, fee-based one-on-one voice conversations with verification and proximity-based discovery." x="81" y="141" width="588" height="225" />

name: Heading 1
raw: <frame id="443:177" name="Heading 1" x="0" y="0" width="567" height="48">
<text id="443:178" name="Key Challenges" x="0" y="0" width="209" height="48" />

<text id="443:179" name="For Users Comment sections feel impersonal; users want real, direct access to creators they follow, with transparent pricing and no hidden subscriptions. For Creators Hundreds of daily messages and unpaid advice requests make it hard to find genuine requests, protect privacy, and monetize their time beyond brand deals. For Existing Platforms Products solve either broadcast reach or recorded personalization, but none offer verified, real-time, creator-controlled conversations." x="0" y="72" width="653" height="275" />

<text id="443:361" name="A voice-first platform for intentional, paid conversations between creators and their audience." x="0" y="61" width="953" height="80" />

<text id="443:362" name="Cirqell moves creator-audience interaction beyond passive comments and unread DMs. It lets creators set their own call rates and availability, and lets users discover nearby, verified creators and talk to them in real time through private, consent-based voice calls." x="0" y="177" width="953" height="75" />
